title: 最強サイコーとはズバリ！！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after Bamboo Memory's senior year has come to a close…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer and Bamboo Memory. I apologize for interrupting your training session, but I was hoping to speak with you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Tazuna! Wow, I don't usually see you around here. What's up?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I actually have some good news for you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The URA has announced Bamboo Memory as the recipient of the Best Sprinter award!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Really! Congratulations, you two!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I DID IT!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I did it, I did it! I DID IT! YESSSSS!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Best Sprinter! Can you believe it?! WOOHOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'M THE BEST OF THE BEST!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It's only natural for her to be overcome with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's right! I won BEST SPRINTER! I'm the ULTIMATE sprinter! YEEEAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory runs about wildly, whooping loudly in celebration and leaving tears glittering like stars in her wake.

text_block_list.name: Student in Tracksuit A
text_block_list.text: So you won Best Sprinter?! That's awesome, Bamboo Memory!

text_block_list.name: Student in Tracksuit B
text_block_list.text: You were amazing at the Sprinters Stakes! But wow, your voice sure carries! I bet people on the other side of the track heard you too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What wonderful news… I have to inform Chiyono O and Ardan immediately.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And I must redouble my own efforts as well!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Heh. Look at her jumping around like a little kid. I doubt there'll be a quiet moment in our room once she gets back.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Congrats, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: We're celebrating for sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just like that, word of Bamboo Memory's achievement spreads across campus like wildfire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, during the award ceremony…

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory! Congratulations on winning Best Sprinter!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much! This is such an honor!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: After your astounding performance in the Mile Championship, I think it's safe to say you're one of the most popular racer in your generation!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Could you please tell us your goals and ambitions for your future races?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… Since you're asking, then I'll take this chance to make an announcement I've been sitting on!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: This award proves my credentials as the ultimate sprinter right now ! However…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's only proof of my current ability! There's no telling if I'll still be the ultimate sprinter in the future!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's why I can't rest on my laurels! I'm gonna keep on turning up the heat so I can win this award again next year!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So listen up…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All you sprinters out there! And not just the current ones—I'm talking to all you would-be sprinters as well!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Come at me with everything you've got! Just try and take this title from me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Let's run in the ultimate race—one grand enough to hold all of our dreams!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: BURN BRIGHT, Twinkle Series! Let's bring the heat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And just like that, Bamboo Memory's passionate declaration sets everyone's expectations ablaze for races yet to come!
